achievements.name: Well-Kept Secret
achievements.desc: Land one of the three secret catches.

achievements.name: Living Myth
achievements.desc: Reach level 250, the top of the ladder.
achievements.title: Living Myth

achievements.name: The Ones That Got Away
achievements.desc: Lose 100 fish. Every angler has stories.

achievements.name: Butterfingers
achievements.desc: Lose 500 fish. At this point the fish tell stories about you.

story.name: Casting Off
story.story: The harbourmaster presses a battered cane rod into your hands. "Everyone starts at Millbrook. Show me you can keep a fish on the line."

story.name: The Miller's Complaint
story.story: Old Hobb the miller swears something in the pond has been snatching his ducklings. He wants the shallows thinned out before he loses another.

story.name: A Fair Price
story.story: Ada runs the fishmonger's stall by the quay. "Bring me stock and I'll teach you what a fish is really worth, and what it isn't."
story.desc: Sell 5 fish to the vendor or on the market.

story.name: Down the Willow
story.story: A bargeman tells of fat chub and pike beneath the willows upriver. The ferry costs coin, but the river pays it back.

story.name: River Colours
story.story: The village schoolmistress is compiling a book of local fishes and needs drawings from life. Every new species you land is a page for her.

story.name: Something in the Reeds
story.story: Reed-cutters have seen a shape moving in the margins at dusk that none of them can name. Whatever it is, it isn't common.

story.name: The Missing Catch
story.story: An old fisherman claims something enormous lives beneath Greyfell Lake. He lost his best line to it forty years ago and has never stopped talking about it.
story.desc: Land a fish over 20 kg at Greyfell Lake.

story.name: Night Watch
story.story: The lamplighter at Greyfell says the lake is a different animal after dark. "Sit out with me one night. You'll see."

story.name: Salt on the Wind
story.story: A letter arrives from a cousin at the Saltmarsh: the estuary is running thick with bass and the flats need another pair of hands.

story.name: Tide Tables
story.story: Your cousin hands you a smudged tide table. "Fish the flood, rest the ebb. Learn it in your bones and the marsh will feed you for life."

story.name: The Merchant's Wager
story.story: Ada wagers you can't move stock to other anglers without her help. Prove her wrong on the open market.
story.desc: List 3 fish on the player market.

story.name: Harrow's Teeth
story.story: Harrow Point breaks boats and men alike. The lighthouse keeper keeps a ledger of every notable fish taken off the rocks, and there is a blank line with your name on it.
story.desc: Land 5 rare-or-better fish at Harrow Point.

story.name: Old Salt's Recipe
story.story: Brannigan, the oldest angler on the quay, offers to teach you his cured-bait recipe. "Fresh fish, sea salt, patience. Mostly patience."
story.desc: Craft 3 baits at the crafting bench.

story.name: Colours of the Reef
story.story: The schoolmistress's book has become a serious work of natural history. She needs the reef fishes, and only the Coral Shoals have them.
story.desc: Discover 10 new species at Coral Shoals.

story.name: The Golden Rumour
story.story: Tavern talk of fish that shine wrong, pale as ghosts, scarred like old warriors, or gleaming like coin. Most anglers never see one.
story.desc: Land any variant fish (scarred, giant, albino or golden).

story.name: Into the Black
story.story: The mangrove guides refuse to pole past the third bend. Something down there upends canoes. Something heavy.
story.desc: Land a fish over 40 kg at Blackwater Mangroves.

story.name: The Long Cold
story.story: The Frozen Reach demands a different kind of angler. Twenty fish through the ice and the northern crews will call you one of their own.
story.desc: Land 20 fish at The Frozen Reach.

story.name: What the Deep Keeps
story.story: Sailors speak of the Sunken Deep in whispers. Bring back proof of what lives below the light and the harbourmaster will drink to your name.
story.desc: Land an epic-or-better fish at The Sunken Deep.

story.name: Light in the Dark
story.story: The last page of the schoolmistress's book is blank. It waits for a legend, and legends do not come to those who wait at home.

patrons.name: Harbourmaster Aldous Crane
patrons.wants: bulk orders of everyday fish for the dock stores
patrons.title: Crane's Confidant

patrons.name: Nettie Marsh
patrons.wants: small fish for her bait tubs and odd-looking specimens for the curious
patrons.title: Nettie's Favourite

patrons.name: Old Tobias
patrons.wants: heavy trophies and proof of skill from the far waters
patrons.title: Tobias's Shipmate

patrons.name: Cook Marisol Vane
patrons.wants: fish by the kilo for the galley pots and the finest cuts for the captain's table
patrons.title: Cook's Choice

frames.name: Hemp Rope
frames.desc: A coil of tarred dock rope.

frames.name: Driftwood
frames.desc: Sun-bleached planks, salt in the grain.

frames.name: Brass Bezel
frames.desc: Polished brass with four rivets, like a ship's gauge.

frames.name: Kelp Wreath
frames.desc: Deep green fronds knotted round the edge.

frames.name: Coral Reef
frames.desc: Warm reef coral and a hint of sunlit water.

frames.name: Sea Glass
frames.desc: Frosted teal glass with a soft inner glow.

frames.name: Abyssal
frames.desc: Black depths and a slow blue pulse.

frames.name: Ghostlight
frames.desc: A cold cavern glow that breathes.

frames.name: Legend's Gold
frames.desc: Ornate gold that catches the light. For those who have earned it.

walls.name: Aged Parchment
walls.desc: Cream vellum, ink-stained edges. Reads like a captain's journal.

walls.name: Driftwood Board
walls.desc: Salt-bleached planks nailed to the dockside notice board.

walls.name: Brass Plaque
walls.desc: Polished brass with riveted corners and a warm gold sheen.

walls.name: Kelp Grotto
walls.desc: Cool green fronds drape the frame; a quiet cove of a page.

walls.name: Ghostlight Cavern
walls.desc: A cold cavern glow breathes across the parchment. Whispers only.

walls.name: Legend's Ledger
walls.desc: Ornate gold trim, deep leather, and a slow shine. For the truly named.

walls.name: Starlit Deck
walls.desc: The night sky over a quiet deck, the Milky Way spilling across the page.
walls.scene: the wooden deck rail of an old sailing ship at night under a vast Milky Way full of stars, calm dark sea, a single hanging lantern, deep blues and indigo

walls.name: Sunlit Reef
walls.desc: Shafts of sunlight over a living coral reef; shoals drift past your entries.
walls.scene: an underwater coral reef with shafts of sunlight falling from the surface, shoals of small silver fish, anemones, turquoise water, soft and dreamy

walls.name: Sunken Wreck
walls.desc: The ribs of a lost galleon in green gloom, treasure glinting between the timbers.
walls.scene: the interior of a sunken galleon wreck in murky green-blue water, broken timbers, a scattering of gold coins glinting, a shaft of pale light, ghostly and atmospheric

walls.name: Storm Sea
walls.desc: Black clouds, white spray and a fork of lightning across the horizon.
walls.scene: a dramatic storm at sea, towering dark waves with white spray, black rolling clouds, a fork of lightning on the horizon, painterly and cinematic

walls.name: Golden Koi Pond
walls.desc: Golden koi glide under drifting blossom on still dusk water.
walls.scene: a serene pond at dusk seen from above with large golden and orange koi gliding beneath the surface, drifting pink cherry blossom petals, soft lantern light reflections

walls.name: Sea Dragon's Hoard
walls.desc: A jade sea dragon coiled around a hoard of pearls in a lightning-lit grotto. The rarest wall in the harbour.
walls.scene: a majestic jade and sapphire sea dragon coiled around a glowing hoard of giant pearls inside a dark sea grotto, lightning flickering through the cave mouth, epic fantasy painting
